purpose: First periodic GFN2-xTB energy/force input; independent initial hypothesis

cell_prior.source: Experimental PE cell prior from this project's Tashiro 1997 literature record and operation note: 7.432, 4.929, 2.545 A. These values were not supplied directly by the user. Only cell metadata was checked; no solved atomic coordinates are read or imported by this builder.
cell_prior.role: Declared experimental-cell prior; cell is not predicted in this first run.

arbitrary_packing_choices.selection_reason: Distinct arbitrary rotations; 17/43 degrees replaces the initial 17/103-degree geometry trial to avoid its short 1.77-A interchain contact. Selection uses only generated geometries, with no energies, diffraction or solved coordinates.

geometric_trials.selection: First tested geometry with minimum interchain distance > 2.1 A.

construction.hydrogen_rule: All four C-C-H angles at each carbon equal acos(-1/3); H-C-H adjusts to the C-C-C angle imposed by c and C-C length.

scope: All H atoms are constructed analytically.
Cell metric is orthorhombic; no final space group or recovered packing is claimed.
Two chains and the two-carbon translation are explicit model assumptions.
A single initial model is an engine check, not a candidate search or method validation.
